_note: From the live fees list PP01-F01 BMSR Fees Rev.04 (Word file linked from barbadosmaritime.com/registration/registration-fees/, page modified 15 May 2026). The live page itself only offers the download. All amounts are in US dollars and copied exactly; only the number format is made consistent (thousands separators, e.g. 2900.00 → 2,900.00), and "/hr." is written "per hour". Each "check" notes a tidy or a question for the client.

vessel.check: the live list gives "5001 - 25000 NRT" then "> 25001 NRT"; the estimator treats anything over 25,000 NRT as the top band, and 2,000 NRT as the 2,000–5,000 band
